text:
anya: quick heads-up — I'm proposing a coordinated cross-repo version bump (api, runtime, console, sdks) tomorrow 10:00 PT. goal: single cut, single changelog consolidation. anyone have hard blockers?

michael: runtime + api code ready. runtime needs the kernel-compat tag in my PR cleared (https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321). CI flaky on amp-quant job but already retriggered. plan: merge runtime first, then api.

sam: console has a CLI flag rename that might be user-visible, will open a short changelog blurb in console repo today. PR is draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/879. need a final decision on whether to ship as minor or patch.

lee: SDKs — node + python both require dep bumps for new auth header. I have branch sdk/bump-auth ready, but packaging for pypi needs a version number. can we agree on x.y.z+1 pattern? also will need tags pushed at merge.

release-bot: automated reminder: release-window cutoff is 2024-06-16T17:00:00Z. any changes after cutoff will be deferred to the next window.

anya: thanks. quick checklist: 1) runtime PR merged and green, 2) api bump PR points to new runtime commit, 3) console changelog entry + docs callout, 4) sdk branches rebased and publish tags ready, 5) update consolidated CHANGELOG.md with per-repo notes.

michael: noted. I will hold runtime merge until CI passes amp-quant. ETA ~2 hours. when merged I'll post the commit SHA here.

sam: console — pinging docs for a short note. @lee will you handle SDK packaging once we confirm version numbers?

lee: yep. I'll wait for the final version string from anya. also will run the changelog consolidation script:

```bash
./scripts/consolidate-release-notes --repos api runtime console sdks --out CHANGELOG.md
```

lee: Heads-up: the script will rewrite toc; prefer we not edit CHANGELOG.md manually after consolidation.

anya: new proposal for versioning: bump minor for api/runtime (backwards compatible with runtime optimizations), patch for console (since CLI flag rename has alias), sdk patch bumps. version scheme: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH where minor increments for perf-affecting runtime changes. agree?

michael: agree from runtime side. we'll add a short compatibility note in runtime/README.

sam: console ok with patch as long as we include alias behavior and doc snippet.

release-bot: deploy-checklist: [ ] tags pushed, [ ] release notes consolidated, [ ] smoke tests green, [ ] binaries uploaded (if any), [ ] release publish job started.

anya: action owners: michael -> runtime merge + announce commit SHA; sam -> finalize console PR + changelog entry; lee -> publish SDK packages and push tags after we merge; anya -> run consolidate script and open the aggregated release PR for a final sign-off. I'll wait for the runtime SHA then start consolidation.

michael: runtime merged: commit 9f8c2a7 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/commit/9f8c2a7). amp-quant job went green on retry.

anya: got it, starting consolidation now. giving everyone a 1hr window to update anything obvious. I'll post the aggregated PR once done. :clock1:

sam: console updated, changelog entry added in console PR 879, left todo to mention alias.

lee: rebased SDK branches, set versions to 1.14.3 (node) and 0.8.2 (python) per agreed scheme. will wait for the consolidated PR to merge before publishing.

anya: aggregated PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/pull/101. includes consolidated CHANGELOG.md and release metadata. requesting quick approvals — please review and approve if everything looks right.

michael: reviewed, lgtm. small nit about wording in runtime note, but not blocking.

sam: approved. left a docs follow-up issue link.

lee: approved, will kick off packaging once PR merges.

release-bot: release PR merged. initiating release publish jobs. smoke tests report: api OK, runtime OK, console minor warnings in CLI help output (non-blocking), sdk packaging queued.

anya: thank you team! final reminder: update any downstream service pins if you maintain them (corner-case: customer sandbox uses pinned sdk version). I'll circulate release notes in #general after publish completes. :tada:
